messages.Plesk está añadiendo la copia a su Gesto: Plesk is adding the backup to its Backup Manager
messages.Subiendo la copia al servidor: Uploading the backup to the server
messages.La copia completa la hace Plesk con «ple: Plesk makes the full backup with “pleskbackup server”; then it is downloaded and checked here.
messages.Copias de un servidor que ya no está con: Backups of a server that is no longer connected
messages.Elige una y pulsa «Restaurar…» para subi: Pick one and click “Restore…” to upload it to one of your Plesk servers.
messages.La copia restaurada trae otras conexione: The restored backup brings other extension connections, so this computer can no longer follow it. Check the result in Plesk and reconnect it if needed.
messages.Plesk terminó la restauración. Revisa en: Plesk finished the restore. Check in the panel that everything is as you expected.
messages.Está en Herramientas y configuración → G: It is in Tools & Settings → Backup Manager. Choose there what to restore.
messages.No se ha cambiado nada en el disco de co: Nothing was changed on the backup drive. Whatever was downloaded is reused next time.
messages.No se pudo copiar el servidor: Could not back up the server
messages.Plesk: copia de {name} guardada ({size},: Plesk: backup of {name} saved ({size}, SHA-256 checked) in {path}
messages.Copias completas de tus servidores Plesk: Full backups of your Plesk servers

A Plesk backup or restore is in progress. Stop it and quit?
